trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on this list, then the platinum unlocks automatically. Keep a chapter save before the ending and prioritize the Chapter 1 meditation before its balcony opportunity disappears.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening story mission, Gone Fishing, by following its objectives through to the mission-complete screen. This is a story unlock and cannot be earned before starting a new game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 1 story arc and let the game register the chapter completion. Before moving on, visit Lucia's balcony meditation spot and make a manual save, since that opportunity is reported to disappear after Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through the Chapter 2 missions until the chapter completion is recorded. The trophy is tied to story progress, so keep a separate chapter save if you want to revisit the chapter later.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story arc. Follow the active story objectives and allow the end-of-chapter transition to finish before quitting.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story arc and wait for the completion notification. Keep your own save from the beginning of the chapter in case you want to revisit its missions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission after completing the preceding story chapters. Save manually before launching it, because the game is reported to have neither mission replay nor New Game Plus.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run when it appears in the story sequence. Finish the mission normally and wait for the result screen to award the trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist as a story mission. Follow its objectives through the escape and let the mission wrap before leaving the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play in the main story. The trophy is awarded on mission completion; use a chapter save if you want a fallback point.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners during the story. Stay with the mission objectives until the final completion state registers.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown as part of the story. Keep a save from the chapter start if you want to replay the sequence, as the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory and allow its mission-complete screen to finish. A manual chapter save is the only reliable fallback for revisiting story content.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the in-game 100% checklist and finish every one of its 35 required tasks. Work through missions, side content, activities and collection goals, checking the game's own completion tracker as you go.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt activities across Leonida. Use safe run-ups and varied locations, and track your total in the game's activity progress rather than repeating a stunt that does not count.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type at least once. Visit the activity markers shown in the game and complete one valid attempt in every distinct category the activity tracker recognizes.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Return to the range to retry weak events, adjusting aim and timing until each challenge's gold requirement is met.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location where the activity is offered. Check the map and activity list for any remaining race, then finish each one in first place.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events, rather than farming the same event. Use the map or activity list to find distinct races and confirm each new win has registered.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and enter one of his fishing challenges, then beat his result. Follow the challenge's catch and timing rules and verify the win before leaving the activity.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade cabinet and finish one complete game. Choose a cabinet you can reliably complete, then stay through its end state so the activity counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission after advancing his stranger strand. Meet Andy at the strand's next available marker and finish its concluding objective; keep chapter saves if you need to revisit story availability.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Advance Kenton's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Follow the strand markers as they appear and wait for the completion state to register.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Progress Billy's strand until its concluding mission becomes available, then finish that mission. Check the map for the strand marker after story progress or time has advanced.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight different stranger mission strands across Leonida. Start available stranger encounters from their map markers and finish each strand's final objective, keeping a list so you do not count a partial strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Continue Randy's stranger strand until its final mission appears, then complete it. Recheck the map after advancing the story if the next strand marker is not currently available.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's strand to its final mission and complete the objective. Return to the map after story progress to find any newly opened strand step.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida, including Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1. That balcony opportunity is reported missable after Chapter 1; meditate there immediately, keep a manual save at every chapter start and before the final mission, and remember there is no mission replay or New Game Plus.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Find Bret's hunting strand and complete its unique-animal objective. Follow the strand's instructions to locate and hunt the specified animal, then confirm the mission registers as complete.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete all three collectible card sets. Search Leonida while checking your collection progress, and return to the relevant set tracker to identify which cards remain.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations around Leonida. Activate the feature as you explore and keep an eye on the counted total so you can revisit unrecorded areas.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges tracked by the game. Check the challenge list for available objectives and vary your play across exploration, activities and combat until the counter reaches the requirement.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, build a four-star Wanted Level, then break line of sight and escape until the heat is gone. Stay together through the escape so the game counts the partner condition.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops consecutively while keeping the Wanted Level active between robberies. Plan a route between shops and evade enough to continue without fully losing the level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by approaching and identifying new models around the state. Explore varied neighborhoods and roads, since repeated sightings of the same model may not advance the unique discovery count.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Use Combat Focus during a fight and take down five enemies before that single activation ends. Save the ability for a group, then keep the targets close enough to engage in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA by triggering the airport departure opportunity described by the game. Explore the airport and follow the encounter prompt; this is a hidden story-related trophy, so check available story opportunities before advancing too far.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Complete the unusual Rhino tank encounter associated with this hidden trophy. Follow the relevant story or activity prompt and survive the sequence until the trophy registers; keep a chapter save as a fallback for hidden content.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and escape without being detected. Prepare before entering, avoid alerting staff or security, and leave the area unseen; retry from a manual save if detection spoils the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Find the vault opportunities around Leonida, complete the robbery and getaway, and track your successful escapes until five are recorded.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck, then escape the response. Watch for the opportunity while exploring, secure the marked cash and break pursuit before the game registers a clean getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida until the game's exploration tracker marks them all discovered. Travel through the full map, including less-traveled roads and outlying places, and use the in-game progress list to spot gaps.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Locate the operations through the game's activity clues, complete the robbery and getaway, and check off each gang as its operation is recorded.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: At Ocean Beach, find a place with a view and enjoy a cocktail. Explore the beachfront for the relevant interaction and complete it; this hidden moment may depend on story availability.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom using the classic break-out method suggested by the trophy. Find the showroom opportunity, trigger the exit sequence and escape the scene.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the bowling follow-through interaction. Stay for the activity's finishing moment so the hidden trophy can register.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach the hidden partnership moment described by the game, then allow its sequence to finish. Keep chapter saves and revisit story opportunities if it does not trigger on the first pass.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make the story or activity choices tracked by this hidden trophy and allow the relevant sequence to resolve. If it does not pop immediately, continue the associated chain and check progress before moving far past the chapter.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Trigger the strange event, fail or miss its first opportunity, then succeed on the follow-up attempt. Return to the encounter and complete the second try so the hidden condition is satisfied.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Explore Leonida and follow the unusual encounter that prompts the game's surprised reaction. Complete the encounter through its final moment; keep chapter saves available in case its opportunity passes.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Use a melee attack from a moving vehicle to knock down a target. Approach safely, perform the drive-by melee action, and confirm the hit registers without leaving the vehicle first.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn a cumulative $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect marked cash during play and use the contact laundering option, checking the total until the full amount is credited.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across shops. Buy items as you play and use a mix of available stores; check spending progress and continue until the tracker credits the total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property available in the game. Use property listings or map markers to find each garage, buy them as funds allow, and confirm the final purchase is complete.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Find distinct vehicles, open the app and complete each registration, checking the app's total before moving on.
